lines.1: 「An executive committee training retreat? That's awfully sudden. We did skip the one in March because we lacked members, though.」
lines.2: 「What exactly is an executive committee training retreat?」
lines.3: 「Precisely what it sounds like: strengthening committee bonds, discussing schedules, and various other matters.」
lines.4: 「Huh, so that's a thing. That's unusual.」
lines.5: 「Search the school websites. Plenty of schools do it.」
lines.7: 「The Tsushima family has nothing to do with student councils, so you are weak on these matters.」
lines.8: 「The Director believes a retreat should be sprung on people. For now, he proposed a day trip to swim in the sea before the official beach opening.」
lines.9: 「The sea...? Isn't it a little early?」
lines.10: 「Nah. Places around Zushi and Shonan open their beaches on June twenty-fifth or twenty-seventh. It's not early.」
lines.11: 「So we're all going to the beach?」
lines.12: 「Yes. The Director has offered to take us.」
lines.14: 「This sounds too good to be true.」
lines.15: I was starting to get a bad feeling.
lines.16: 「Apparently, he wants to show off his cruiser.」
lines.17: 「That's a questionable motive for an adult... but it does make sense.」
lines.22: 「I was planning to work up a sweat with the tennis club.」
lines.25: 「You're not taking no for an answer at all.」
lines.26: 「...Well, tennis or swimming, either is fine. I have no objections.」
lines.27: 「Again, so casual. You change gears fast.」
lines.28: 「There's no need to overthink it. We're basically going to the beach to swim and have fun, right?」
lines.34: 「Training in the sea should be worthwhile. Right, Leo?」
lines.35: Apparently, my attendance was already decided.
lines.36: 「I will go as your supervising teacher.」
lines.38: 「It's already decided...? Well, I don't really mind.」
lines.39: I felt sorry for both of us.
lines.40: 「If Nagomin comes, we'll have perfect attendance.」
lines.43: 「Come to think of it, where are we going?」
lines.45: 「What?! Th-The island where they exile people?!」
lines.46: 「The water is clean enough for swimming. And we will have it to ourselves.」
lines.49: 「Huh, that's a surprise. I expected, 'Go by yourselves. I'll stay home and talk to the walls.'」
lines.50: 「Don't turn me into a shut-in without asking.」
lines.54: 「Well, I hate Coconut too! Screw you!」
lines.57: There was no helping these two.
lines.58: 「Then meet in front of the school gates at ten Friday morning. This is technically an official activity, so come in uniform. There is somewhere to change into your swimsuits once we arrive.」
lines.59: 「I recommend bringing water and a survival knife.」
lines.60: Everyone laughed, assuming Inori-sensei was joking.
lines.61: At the time, I never dreamed what was waiting for us there.
